message:
I need to build the HDF5 library. Let me try building it. But first, let me understand the HDF5 file format better so I can construct the file manually. Let me look at the HDF5 file format specification and understand the structure needed.

Actually, let me first try to build the library so I can create a valid HDF5 file:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 && mkdir -p build-dir && cd build-dir && cmake -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS:BOOL=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING:BOOL=OFF -DHDF5_BUILD_EXAMPLES:BOOL=OFF -DHDF5_BUILD_TOOLS:BOOL=OFF -DHDF5_ENABLE_Z_LIB_SUPPORT:BOOL=ON .. 2>&1 | tail -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
